usedFor: SendBird AI Chatbot holds chat channels and users, and Google Sheets logs events as rows through “Add Multiple Rows”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Group Channel” in SendBird AI Chatbot, then “Add Multiple Rows” in Google Sheets
bestTemplate.why: Each new group channel becomes a row, giving you a running log of channels.

watchOut: “User Blocked” and “User Unblocked” are separate triggers, so a log of blocks needs both.
